submission_instructions: Visit registered FKTP for initial examination. If medical condition requires specialist treatment, FKTP issues online electronic referral (Surat Rujukan). Present NIK KTP and referral barcode at hospital admissions. Hospital generates SEP (Surat Eligibilitas Peserta). No cash payment required for standard entitlements.
filing_deadlines: Referral valid for 90 days from date of issuance by FKTP for recurring treatment
preauthorization_requirements: Prior examination and electronic referral from registered FKTP mandatory
reimbursement_procedures: Direct settlement (cashless) between hospital and BPJS Kesehatan under INA-CBGs diagnosis-related group tariff
published_processing_timeline: Immediate electronic verification at admissions desk
status_inquiry_channels: Petugas BPJS SATU di Rumah Sakit
dispute_escalation_guidance: Contact BPJS SATU (Siap Membantu) petugas di rumah sakit, atau hotline 165

claims_administrator: PT Asuransi Allianz Life Indonesia (Claims Department)
submission_instructions: For non-partner hospital treatments, pay initial expenses, collect original hospital receipts, complete formulir klaim with treating physician signature, and submit via Allianz eAZy Connect portal or mail to Allianz Tower Jakarta.
filing_deadlines: Within 30 calendar days from the date of discharge or consultation
required_forms: Formulir Klaim Asuransi Kesehatan Allianz Asli
preauthorization_requirements: Required for planned surgeries at least 7 days before admission
reimbursement_procedures: Claim assessed against policy benefit table. Approved payment transferred to policyholder bank account.
published_processing_timeline: 7 to 14 working days after receipt of complete original documents
dispute_escalation_guidance: Internal Dispute Resolution Unit Allianz, or escalate to OJK Kontak 157 and LAPS SJK.
